source: Official ESPN public core CFB odds JSON; provider source is ESPN with reported bookmaker label, not direct bookmaker attestation
identified_causes: ESPN emits provider name Draft Kings in one public response variant; earlier canonical list accepted DraftKings only.
ESPN spreadOdds prices are JSON whole-number floats (-110.0, -112.0); original strict integer-only American odds parser rejected them.
changes: Exact provider-label alias Draft Kings to canonical DraftKings.
Local adapter to convert only finite exact whole-number floats to strict American odds integer parser; rejects fractional, boolean, NaN, Infinity and out-of-range.
Independent home/away current team pointSpread cross-check when present to verify signed home convention.
Append-only repackaging of already captured valid original pregame JSON bytes: no network access during recovery; original timestamps and source ZIPs unchanged.
Scheduled snapshot workflow always reparses original prior captures, then captures new actual free public ESPN lines and grades paired forecasts using genuine original quotes.

verification.quote_provenance: Original ESPN public response, SHA verified, observed before kickoff

limitations: 254 quotes are observations across several runs, NOT independent games.
Only 41 games have a joint pair and valid quote, not 45.
Quote observed time is verifiable capture time, not independently bookmaker's first publication time.
Current ESPN line may differ from any chosen book's close, and can move.
ATS outcomes are not available until final scores appear; do not claim cover accuracy now.
